forward.derivation: maximal contiguous prefix from week 1 where every scheduled game has total_line and spread_line
forward.spread_convention: positive spread_line means home favored; home=total/2+spread/2, away=total/2-spread/2
forward.top_five_tie_policy: higher mean, then canonical team code

delta_event.contracted_response: FAIL CLOSED: do not overwrite the last verified snapshot or tags; a shorter priced horizon can reflect an unpriced game or source hiccup and must be reviewed before changing the decision window.

provenance.roles: inside-5 share and YMS are 2025-role priors and say so

rb_backfield.replacement: 2025 player carries divided by the complete untrimmed 2025 RB carry total on that historical team; multi-team rows stay split
rb_backfield.retired_counterfactual: the same committed usage rows grouped by each player's 2026 depth-chart team
rb_backfield.grouping_only_intermediate: the retired trimmed player rows regrouped by their stored historical team before adding the untrimmed split ledger
rb_backfield.season_scope: all 2025 season types present in the weekly source, preserving the prior all-week basis
rb_backfield.multi_team_player_policy: all split rows contribute to team denominators; a player with positive carries for multiple teams has a null individual share

provenance.proxy: routes = on-field membership on team dropbacks (participation 2025); counts pass-block snaps as routes

rb_inside5.observation_rule: 2025 inside-five sample has n > 0; k=0 is observed

rb_backfield_share.observation_rule: the untrimmed 2025 player-team carry ledger contains one positive historical team for the canonical player and that team's observed RB carry total is at least 100; observed zero is included, absence or a positive multi-team split is null
rb_backfield_share.p50_method: upper middle observation for even n; preserved stage-2 convention

rb_backfield_share_counterfactual_curren.observation_rule: same usage_2025.json rows assigned to 2026 depth-chart teams; retained only as the retired same-build baseline
rb_backfield_share_counterfactual_curren.p50_method: upper middle observation for even n; retired stage-2 baseline

rb_backfield_share_counterfactual_histor.observation_rule: trimmed usage_2025.json player rows assigned to their stored historical team; grouping-only intermediate
rb_backfield_share_counterfactual_histor.p50_method: upper middle observation for even n; grouping-only intermediate

on_field_dropback_share_reference.observation_rule: 2025 TE population with at least 100 observed on-field team dropbacks; pass-block snaps count

forward_implied_total.observation_rule: all canonical teams in the maximal fully priced horizon

thresholds.note: qualification floors: WR/TE routes-proxy >= 150/100, QB 150+ attempts, RB with 2025 usage; proxies count pass-block snaps as on-field dropbacks (stated weakness), so thresholds are percentiles of OUR distribution, never PFF-unit imports

qb_gap.definition: top-12 QB season finishes 2016-2025 (n=120), rushing class = rush yds/g >= that season's p75 among 8+ game QBs; season TOTAL points under each scoring

on_field_dropback_share.basis: 2025 regular-season team dropbacks with the player listed on offense; pass-block snaps are included
